lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah, Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 12,600 shares for up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold.
Proceeds are in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the trigger, shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, is recent, 66 days ago.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026 is recent. Possible gain up to ₹1.26 crore, before offer expenses and taxes.
Shares 'Atul Hiralal Shah' and 'Bakul Hiralal Shah' share surname and middle name, a family link worth noting. Retained value ₹3.97 crore (estimate).
